summary: Panama City Beach should retain its standalone municipal control row. Official city materials show a live Panama City Beach Police Department with a current chief, command staff, and direct city non-emergency administration, while FDLE's Bay County county-and-municipal offense reports publish Panama City Beach Police Department as a substantive municipal row in both 2020 and 2021. The current 2024 full-fill state is therefore not Bay County sheriff replacement, contract policing, or target invalidity; it is a post-2021 Florida publication/continuity gap, because the official FDLE FIBRS workbook has no Panama City Beach row on the 2021-2025 Q3 sheets and the official FBI CDE 2024 roster still lists FL0030600 as a City agency with is_nibrs false.
